neighbours.label: verbs of scrutinising something against a standard or another thing: compare, examine, evaluate, review, contrast, inspect
fire: In the study, the authors compared survival rates across three hospitals.
Every spring the auditors examine the accounts of each branch office.
Afterwards the panel will review all applications submitted by Friday.
In class we had to compare the two poems line by line.
Last week the engineers carefully inspected the cracks in the old dam.
Doctors will evaluate how well the new drug works in older adults.
Historians have long contrasted the two empires' approaches to trade.
Shoppers who compare prices online often save a lot of money.
quiet: In the study, the authors gathered survival rates across three hospitals.
Every spring the auditors close the accounts of each branch office.
Afterwards the panel will print all applications submitted by Friday.
In class we had to memorize the two poems line by line.
Last week the engineers carefully repaired the cracks in the old dam.
Doctors will explain how the new drug works in older adults.
Historians have long admired the two empires' approaches to trade.
Shoppers who order groceries online often save a lot of money.
